prompt: Announce the neighborhood watch's monthly patrol as a WWE faction entrance. They have matching windbreakers.
response:
*(The arena lights dim. A single, pulsing spotlight scans the restless crowd. The titantron flickers to life, showing a rapid-cut montage: a lawn gnome being stolen in grainy night-vision, a garage door slowly closing, a suspicious van driving by, and finally, a crisp, high-definition shot of a perfectly manicured hedge. A generic, synth-heavy stock music track about "taking back the night" begins to play.)*

**RING ANNOUNCER:** "Making their way to the ring... hailing from the quiet, well-lit cul-de-sacs of this very subdivision... at a combined weight of 'none of your business, please just keep the noise down'..."

*(The synth track is abruptly cut by a record scratch, replaced by the opening power chords of a generic but somehow aggressive rock anthem. The words "CIVIC MINDED" flash on the screen in a bold, Arial font.)*

**RING ANNOUNCER:** "They are the enforcers of the HOA, the sentinels of the sidewalk... This is... THE NEIGHBORHOOD WATCH!"

*(The curtain parts, not with pyro, but with the aggressive glare of four high-powered LED flashlights sweeping the crowd, momentarily blinding a fan in a Cena shirt. Out steps the faction, moving with the coordinated, purposeful stride of people who have been practicing this in a driveway.)*

**LEADER (Frank "The Facilitator" Franklin):**
A man in his late 50s, wearing the team windbreaker—a shimmering, safety-vest silver with reflective strips that blaze under the arena lights. He carries a clipboard with "INCIDENT REPORT" embossed on the back in large, friendly letters. He doesn't walk to the ring; he power-walks, pumping his arms with intense, aerobic efficiency. He pauses to sternly point at a fan's spilled popcorn, shaking his head and making a "clean it up" gesture before continuing his march.

**ENFORCER (Brenda "The Brick" Brickowski):**
A stout woman whose windbreaker is slightly tighter, as if it’s containing a barely-leashed storm. She’s holding a heavy-duty Maglite not as a tool, but as a melee weapon, tapping it menacingly into her open palm. She scans the front row, yelling, "I CAN SEE YOU! YES, YOU WITH THE VAPE! THAT'S A CLOUD OF CONCERN!" She mimes writing a very stern note on an imaginary pad.

**TAG TEAM SPECIALISTS (The Mulcher Brothers, Gary & Larry):**
Two identical men with identical, meticulously trimmed mustaches. Their windbreakers are accessorized with utility belts holding hand sanitizer, dog-waste bags, and a folded copy of the city's noise ordinance. They move in perfect sync, stopping every few steps to perform a synchronized "turn and look" in opposite directions, nodding once at each other before continuing. One of them is holding a leaf blower, which he revs menacingly, drowning out a nearby fan's boos.

*(As they reach the ring, Frank doesn't climb the stairs. He stops, pulls out a small measuring tape from his windbreaker pocket, and measures the distance between the bottom rope and the apron, nodding with grim satisfaction. They all then enter the ring in a single-file, orderly fashion.)*

*(In the center of the ring, Frank demands a microphone. The rock anthem cuts. The only sound is the faint, tinny walkie-talkie chatter emanating from Brenda's pocket: "Unit 4, we have a visual on a questionable sedan... over.")*

**FRANK "THE FACILITATOR" FRANKLIN:**
*(He doesn't shout. He speaks with the calm, condescending tone of a man explaining a zoning variance.)*

"Last month, our patrol logged a 47% increase in unapproved basketball hoops and a staggering number of bins left at the curb past 6 PM on a non-collection day. A clear violation of Section 4, Subsection B. The situation was... *unsightly*."

*(The Mulcher Brothers shake their heads in synchronized disappointment, their mustaches quivering with disgust.)*

**FRANK:**
"This month, we're implementing a new initiative. We're calling it... 'Project Porch Light.' A zero-tolerance policy for shadows. A 360-degree, 24/7 vigilance campaign. We will be conducting random walk-bys. We will be noting license plates. We will be... *checking in on things*."

*(He leans in, his voice dropping to a threatening whisper that the microphone amplifies into a terrifying hiss.)*

"So consider this your one and only warning. Keep your lawns green, your music down, and your garage doors closed. Because if we see something... we will say something. And you will be reported to the proper authorities."

*(He drops the mic. The synth-heavy "taking back the night" theme song kicks back in. The Neighborhood Watch stands shoulder-to-shoulder in the center of the ring, windbreakers gleaming, and raises their flashlights in a synchronized, four-point salute to the ceiling, scanning the rafters for any unauthorized birds' nests. The crowd doesn't know whether to boo or nervously edge towards the exits.)*
